newsitem.title: USA: Vik Brothers downgraded by A.M. Best.
newsitem.headline: Vik Brothers downgraded by A.M. Best.

text.p: A.M. Best Co. said it has lowered its rating on Vik Brothers Insurance Group to B minus (adequate) from B plus (Very Good) and placed it under review with negative implications.
This action takes Vik's rating from the Secure category into the Vulnerable category, A.M. Best said.

The downgrade is based on the deterioration of Vik's financial condition during 1996, which has led to the difficulty in closing the acquisition of Vik by Highlands Insurance Group Inc, A.M. Best said.
After the June 1996 announcement that a definitive agreement had been signed for Highlands to acquire Vik, A.M. Best said it had affirmed Vik's B plus rating.

The affirmation was based on the signing of the agreement and the anticipated benefits of the transaction, including the reduction in dividend demands on Vik, since its debt and preferred stock and servicing burdens would have been essentially transferred to Highlands.
During the first nine months of 1996, Vik's surplus declined 15 percent because of poor underwriting performance, largely reflecting catastrophe losses, A.M. Best said.
This material change in Vik's financial condition has raised doubts as to whether the transaction will close, A.M. Best said.
If the transaction is canceled, the group's B minus rating will be under downward pressure as a result of Vik's excessive financial leverage and poor profitability, A.M. Best said.

The rating will remain under review pending the outcome of the transaction and the evaluation of Vik's year-end financial condition and management's plans to reverse deteriorating underwriting trends, A.M. Best said..

This rating action applies to the following members of Vik Brothers Insurance Group: American Professionals Insurance Co.; LMI Insurance Co.; NN Insurance Co.; Northwestern National Casualty Co.; Northwestern National County Mutual Insurance Co.; Pacific Auto Insurance Co.; Pacific National Insurance Co.; State Capital Insurance Co.; Statesman Ins. Co.
